title: The NDA is acknowledged electronically, not by DocuSign; one full signature at the end
statement: The applicant bank acknowledges the NDA as an electronic agreement — name, title and date captured, accept and move on — instead of executing it through DocuSign. No e-sign workflow runs at the NDA step. A single full signature is taken at the end of the journey, so the partner is not asked to sign through DocuSign several times.

evidence.excerpt: how the customer was going to acknowledge that NDA instead of it being a DocuSign, it being an electronic agreement, capturing their name, their title, and the date like Jonathan had suggested
So basically we are saying let's not have any e-sign workflow as part of NDA. Have it a digital signature or accept, I accept and move on.
